description: Source code for the UserService class in the Mattermost plugin API, providing methods to manipulate user data such as retrieval, creation, update, deletion, status management, profile image handling, permission checks, LDAP attributes, and access tokens.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: A service class providing user management functionalities in the Mattermost plugin API.

methods.name: GetByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email address.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists users based on search options.

methods.name: ListInChannel
methods.description: Lists users in a specific channel with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: ListInTeam
methods.description: Lists users in a specific team with pagination.

methods.name: Search
methods.description: Searches for users based on criteria.

methods.name: HasPermissionTo
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific system permission.

methods.name: HasPermissionToTeam
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific team permission.

methods.name: HasPermissionToChannel
methods.description: Checks if a user has a specific channel permission.

methods.name: RolesGrantPermission
methods.description: Checks if roles grant a specific permission.

methods.name: GetLDAPAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP attributes for a user.

methods.name: CreateAccessToken
methods.description: Creates a new access token for a user.
